recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-perspective shot looking through a weathered chain-link fence and padlock toward a yellow wooden doghouse situated in a vibrant green field under a clear blue sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground fence framing the central doghouse subject
Contrast between the industrial metal textures and the organic green grass
Diagonal tension created by the fence posts and the angled text
coreInvariants: Yellow wooden doghouse with a dark entrance hole

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The doghouse is centered in the mid-ground, scaled to occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The silver padlock on the left fence post acts as a high-contrast focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the padlock, follows the fence line up to the top text, then drops down to the doghouse center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is open blue sky, providing breathing room for display text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant green (grass) and blue (sky) provide the environmental base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted gray and silver (fence/lock) provide industrial contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellow (doghouse) and rust-red (text outline) draw focus to the center.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the landscape elements contrasted with desaturated, weathered textures on the man-made objects.

letterConstructionRules: Upper text uses a clean, wide-set sans-serif with slight transparency
Lower text uses a heavy, blocky slab-serif with a weathered, stamped texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lower text features a thick white outline and a secondary dark red drop shadow/outline

composition.overlap: sits on top of doghouse surface

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a clean, airy sans-serif with a heavy, textured slab-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure and square terminals.
Matches the clean, wide-set sans-serif for the sky text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photo of a yellow wooden doghouse in a lush green field, viewed through a weathered chain-link fence with a silver padlock on the left. Barbed wire at the top, clear blue sky gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a heavy, textured slab-serif title in rust-red with a thick white outline over the doghouse, tilted slightly. Add a wide-spaced white sans-serif subtitle in the sky area, tilted in the opposite direction.

verificationChecks: Is the padlock clearly visible in the foreground?
Does the doghouse have a weathered yellow paint texture?
Is the sky text placed behind the foreground fence post?
Is the slab-serif text distressed and textured?

adjustableVariables: Amount of rust on the fence

mustAchieve: Realistic depth of field between fence and doghouse

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the fence post overlaps the sky text correctly.
Check that the doghouse text looks like it is painted on the wood.
Verify the green of the grass is vibrant but not neon.
Confirm the padlock has a metallic sheen.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine industrial foreground framing (fence/locks) with a central rustic subject (wood/grass) and high-contrast, textured slab-serif typography.
